# Mortal Shell II Guide

> Fan-made community guide hub for Mortal Shell II (mortalshell2.online), an English-language souls-like game guide site. Game facts are checked against the official Steam page and mortalshell.com; launch-specific data (shell stats, weapon costs, boss names) is marked as pending and will be verified against the release build.

## Pages

- [Mortal Shell 2 Beginner Guide](https://mortalshell2.online/beginner-guide/): no-stamina combat and the resolve economy, first shells, posture-break executions, and Standard vs Devout Edition start times
- [Mortal Shell 2 Best Build](https://mortalshell2.online/best-build/): the eight shells as build classes, Game8's attributed per-shell loadouts for weapons, sidearms, and seals
- [Mortal Shell 2 Walkthrough](https://mortalshell2.online/walkthrough/): the nine regions, the ten major bosses gating the critical path, and the shells and weapons hidden off the golden route in an interconnected world with 60+ dungeons
- [Mortal Shell 2 Bosses](https://mortalshell2.online/bosses/): all ten major bosses in recommended order with locations, the nine regions, and the fights that pay out shells and weapons
- [Mortal Shell 2 Shells](https://mortalshell2.online/shells/): all eight lost warrior shells, possession, every unlock location from Tiel to Sariel, and the memories that unlock each shell's story
- [Mortal Shell 2 Weapons](https://mortalshell2.online/weapons/): all 8 melee weapons and sidearms, Tarstone upgrades and the Tarforge, and the posture-break system that enables critical execution strikes
- [Mortal Shell 2 Tips](https://mortalshell2.online/tips/): the resolve economy, posture-break executions, non-linear dungeon exploration, and Game8's attributed boss-prep habits
- [Mortal Shell 2 Performance Fix](https://mortalshell2.online/performance-fix/): Playstack's launch Hotfix 1, the Keyboard Bindings save-file workaround, and the shader cache fix for PC crashes and stuttering
- [About This Guide](https://mortalshell2.online/about/): how this fan-made guide researches, verifies, attributes, and discloses its facts

## Key facts (core verified 2026-08-17; launch data verified 2026-08-20)

- Release date: August 20, 2026 (out now), worldwide, on PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S
- Developer: Cold Symmetry. Publisher: Playstack
- Combat has no stamina gauge: landing aggressive melee hits generates resolve, which funds defensive skills and weapon arts
- Eight possessable lost-warrior shells, each with a unique ability tree and personal lore unlocked through memories
- The world is a compact, interconnected open world containing more than 60 dungeons
- Ten major bosses gate the critical path across nine regions, from Magdalena the Lady of the Woods to Zmey the Unbidden (verified 2026-08-20)
- Consecutive melee strikes build posture damage; a full posture break staggers enemies for critical execution strikes
- The Devout Edition grants up to 72 hours of advance access before the worldwide release
